errorGuardar: We couldn't save that change. Please try again.
bienvenidaTitulo: Your school is up and running.
bienvenidaCuerpo: Let's get it ready in a few minutes. Everything you touch here can be changed later, so don't overthink it.
bienvenidaPunto1: Give it a name, a logo and a color
bienvenidaPunto2: Create your first course without leaving this screen
bienvenidaPunto3: Invite your first students, if you want
nombreCuerpo: It's the name your students will see when they sign in, and the one that signs the emails you send them.
nombrePlaceholder: Sanz Academy, Aribau Training, Language School…
nombreAviso: Right now it's called “{nombre}”, which came from your email at purchase. Give it its real name.
marcaCuerpo: Your logo and your color make students feel they're in your school — not in some generic tool.
marcaLogoArrastra: Drag your logo here or click to choose it
marcaLogoFormatos: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP · 2 MB max · square works best
marcaLogoOpcional: Don't have it handy? Carry on without it — you can upload it later from Admin → Branding.
marcaLogoErrorTipo: That file won't work as a logo. It needs to be PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP.
marcaLogoErrorPeso: That image is {mb} MB and the maximum is 2 MB. Try a lighter version.
marcaLogoErrorSubida: We couldn't upload the logo. Please try again.
marcaModoSoloAyuda: For logos that carry the name inside: shown whole, at its own size.
marcaModoConNombreAyuda: For square or textless logos: the name goes next to it.
marcaColorAyuda: Pick one, or fine-tune with the bar. You'll see it applied instantly.
marcaVista: This is what your students will see
cursoCuerpo: A school with content explains itself. Give it a title and we'll create it as a draft: your students won't see it until you publish it.
cursoVacio: Write a title to create the course.
cursoCreadoAyuda: You can add lessons to it anytime from My courses.
cursoYaTienes: {n, plural, one {You already have a course} other {You already have # courses}}, so this step is done. You can create another one if you like.
cursoError: We couldn't create the course. Try again, or do it later from My courses.
alumnosCuerpo: Write their emails and we'll send each one an invitation to enter your school with their own password.
alumnosVacio: There's no valid email in the list.
alumnosMax: Up to {max} emails fit here at once. For a long list, use the CSV import in Users → Import.
alumnosEnviadas: {n, plural, one {1 invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}.
alumnosDespues: If you'd rather do it later, one-by-one invites and CSV import live in Admin → Users.
cobrosTitulo: Will you charge for your courses?
cobrosCuerpo: You can sell your courses with card payments through Stripe. The money goes straight to your account — we never touch it.
cobrosCuerpoConectar: Connect your payouts and your students can pay you by card. It takes a few minutes and there are no keys to paste.
correoCuerpo: Right now, emails to your students go out from Didacta. If you want them sent from your own address, set it up right here.
correoAyuda: It needs a few technical details that whoever manages your email or website usually has. There's no rush at all.
resumenCuerpo: Your school now has your name and your look. This is its address — share it with anyone.
resumenDominioPropio: Prefer your own domain, like “classroom.yourschool.com”? Set it up from Admin → Domains.
resumenPendienteAyuda: No rush: all of this also lives in your admin panel.
